subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises that the same spelling can represent different sounds (bread, read)

show.line: Bread and read. Both have ea, but they sound different! The same letters can make two sounds.

rounds.prompt: Which word has ea that sounds like bread?
Which word has ea that sounds like read?
This word has ea like bread. It is light and comes from a bird. Say it.
Sounds like bread, or sounds like read? Sort the words.
Tap the word that sounds different from the others. Tea, sea, head.
rounds.praise: Yes! Head has the bread sound.

rounds.text: I eat bread by the sea.
accept: i eat bread by the sea

hints: Try both sounds. Which one makes a real word?
ea can say the sound in bread or the sound in read.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word. Head.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Here ea says the sound in bread. Head.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's try both together. Heed? No. Head, like bread. Yes!

parent_line: Can read ea words with both sounds, like bread and read.
